verdict.rationale: Notion's own docs state the REST API can read/create/update 'nearly everything' (pages, databases, users, comments) and there's an OpenAPI spec plus webhooks for real-time events, showing broad but explicitly not complete UI parity. Missing for 10: confirmation that workspace administration, permissions/sharing settings, views/formatting UI features, and other non-content operations are fully API-accessible, and no independent/hands-on evidence testing this parity claim.
